home.cityFilmAlt: Aerial view of the river and the city's rooftops at golden hour
home.featuredEmpty: There are no featured properties at the moment. Tell us what you are looking for and we will let you know as soon as something suitable comes up.
home.finalLede: Call us, message us on Viber or WhatsApp, or email us. We reply the same working day, and within 24 hours at the latest.
home.heroLede: Carefully selected properties in Belgrade and across Serbia — and advice that outlasts the purchase.
home.heroMediaAlt: Penthouse living room at blue hour, overlooking the river and the lights of Belgrade
home.introStatement: We believe the right property is not so much chosen as recognised. That is why we select fewer, check more and guide you through every step — from the first viewing to the keys in your hand.
home.neighborhoodsLede: From Vračar and Dorćol to New Belgrade and Novi Sad — we choose the neighbourhood first, then the apartment.
home.numbersDemo: Demo figures — to be replaced with the agency's real data.
home.numbersMediaAlt: Facade of an Art Nouveau building in Belgrade at golden hour
home.processLede: Five steps, from our first conversation to handing over the keys. At each step you know what comes next and who is guiding you.
home.processMediaAlt: Entrance hall with double doors and brass keys on a stone table
home.processStep1Body: We visit the property, listen to your plans and give you a realistic price range, with the reasoning behind it.
home.processStep2Body: We put the paperwork in order, advise on what is worth refreshing and take professional photographs.
home.processStep3Body: A listing in four languages, a 360° tour or a 3D walkthrough, and targeted advertising aimed at buyers in Serbia and the diaspora.
home.processStep4Body: We conduct every viewing, screen buyers for serious interest and negotiate on your behalf.
home.processStep5Body: We prepare the contract with a lawyer and oversee the notarisation, the tax filing and the handover of the keys.
home.servicesBuyBody: We find, verify and negotiate on your behalf. You only see properties whose paperwork has passed our checks.
home.servicesRelocationBody: Buying from abroad, with no need to travel. Live viewings by video call, and power of attorney arranged through our lawyer.
home.servicesRentBody: Reliable tenants and sound tenancy agreements. We vet every applicant and manage the handover.
home.servicesSellBody: The right price, the right buyers, without the stress. We prepare the property, photograph it and see negotiations through to signing.
home.servicesToursBody: Open to everyone, around the clock. 360° tours and 3D walkthroughs of selected properties.
home.servicesValuationBody: An indicative online estimate in two minutes, and a detailed on-site analysis drawing on comparable sales in your neighbourhood.
home.toursLede: Virtual 360° tours and 3D walkthroughs of selected properties.
home.toursMediaAlt: Interior dissolving into a bronze point cloud, showing a 3D scan of an apartment
home.valuationLede: An indicative estimate in two minutes, based on average prices in your neighbourhood. No obligation, and no unsolicited calls.
home.valuationMediaAlt: Apartment floor plan on a desk with a brass ruler, in afternoon light
home.valuationNote: Would you like a more precise figure? An agent will visit your property free of charge and value it based on actual transactions in your neighbourhood.

mortgage.heading: Mortgage calculator
mortgage.youngNote: Buyers aged 35 or under purchasing their first home can use the state housing loan scheme, which requires a lower deposit. Check the terms with your bank.
mortgage.disclaimer: An indicative calculation using the annuity (equal repayments) method. The effective interest rate (EIR) and final terms depend on the bank, insurance and your creditworthiness.

costs.heading: Total purchase costs
costs.transferTaxNote: The seller is liable by law, but contracts often pass it on to the buyer.
costs.firstHome: A first-time buyer may be exempt from this tax on 40 m² for themselves and 15 m² for each household member. The exemption is claimed from the tax office, so we do not deduct it here.
costs.vatNote: The first sale of a new build is subject to VAT instead of transfer tax. A first-time buyer can claim a VAT refund on 40 m² for themselves and 15 m² for each household member.
costs.agencyFeeNote: The exact amount is agreed in the brokerage agreement.
costs.extras: Costs on top of the price
costs.disclaimer: Approximate figures, for information only. This is not tax or legal advice.
